cross_cutting_issues.description: Protocol (HYPOTHESES_V2.md, PREREGISTRATION_MANIFEST, PHASE_0_GATE) declares Holm-Bonferroni with family n=12 (H1-H12 combined). V1 artifacts (FINAL_STATISTICAL_RESULTS.json, phase3/STATISTICAL_ANALYSIS.json) use plain Bonferroni with n=6 (H1-H6 only). These produce different corrected alphas: protocol=0.0042 vs v1 artifacts=0.0017. Plain Bonferroni is more conservative than Holm-Bonferroni, but n=6 gives alpha=0.0017 which is more conservative than Holm n=12 at most ranks. The inconsistency must be resolved for transparent reporting.
cross_cutting_issues.corrective_action: Recompute all reported p-values under the Holm-Bonferroni n=12 protocol. Document v1 / v2 families separately if needed.

cross_cutting_issues.description: H9 specifies a paired permutation test as the required statistical test. H10 specifies a permutation test across SP types. Neither has been run. Current H9 verdict rests only on a point estimate (delta=-0.0453 < 0.0335) without a p-value.
cross_cutting_issues.corrective_action: Run permutation_test_delta() from e1_statistical_analysis.py for H9. Implement SP-type permutation test for H10. Record p-values in artifacts.

cross_cutting_issues.description: HYPOTHESES_V2.md specifies: Cohen's h (H7, H8, H12), Glass's delta (H9), Kendall's W (H10). None are reported in current artifacts. FINAL_STATISTICAL_RESULTS.json reports Glass's delta direction for v1 H3 but not a value.
cross_cutting_issues.corrective_action: Compute Cohen's h from thresholded predictions for H7/H8/H12. Compute Glass's delta for H9. Compute Kendall's W when H10 data is available.

cross_cutting_issues.description: Five of eight phase3 baselines (B02, B03, B04, B07, B08) and B07_v2 produce threshold=1.000001 (predict all CHANGED), yielding identical F1=0.659459. The B07_v2 F1=0.659459 in PHASE_2_GATE.json is the same majority-class value. F1 comparisons between these baselines are meaningless. AUROC is unaffected and correctly used as primary metric.
cross_cutting_issues.corrective_action: Do not compare F1 values between baselines with degenerate thresholds. Mark F1 as 'majority_class_baseline' in artifact notes when threshold>=1.0. AUROC remains valid primary metric.

cross_cutting_issues.description: FINAL_STATISTICAL_RESULTS.json reports mcnemar_p=1.0 for SBG vs B02_AST comparison. A McNemar p=1.0 with non-overlapping CIs is paradoxical and requires verification. Possible causes: all disagreements are symmetric (equal b and c in contingency table), or implementation error. Per-pair prediction arrays are needed to verify.
cross_cutting_issues.corrective_action: Reconstruct per-pair prediction arrays for SBG_full and B02_AST. Recompute McNemar test manually. Verify b and c counts in the 2x2 contingency table.

cross_cutting_issues.description: H9 requires stratified analysis of SC-3 (off-by-one) and SC-11 (incorrect constant) separately, where static similarity=1.0. This is a blocking safeguard (SAFEGUARD-4). The current H9 verdict reports only the aggregate delta=-0.0453 without the SC-3/SC-11 sub-analysis.
cross_cutting_issues.corrective_action: Filter test pairs by transformation_type in [SC-3, SC-11]. Compute dynamic similarity separately for these pairs. Report delta and CI for this hard-negative subset.

cross_cutting_issues.description: Multiple pairs share the same base_program (e.g., api_rate_limiter appears in many pairs: SP-2_s0, SP-2_s1, SP-2_s2, SP-3_s0, etc.). Bootstrap sampling treats all pairs as i.i.d. but pairs sharing a base program are correlated through the base program's similarity scores. This violates the i.i.d. assumption of standard bootstrap.
cross_cutting_issues.corrective_action: Consider cluster bootstrap (resample by base_program rather than by pair) to account for within-program pair correlation. At minimum, document this as a limitation. The effect is likely small if each program contributes a small fraction of total pairs.

cross_cutting_issues.category: Bootstrap percentile indexing — minor conservative bias
cross_cutting_issues.description: compute_metrics uses boot[25] and boot[974] from 1000 sorted bootstrap samples. The exact 2.5th percentile position is index 24.975 (0-based). Using index 25 gives a 1-sample conservative bias on the lower bound. This is common practice and negligible (0.1% coverage excess).
cross_cutting_issues.corrective_action: No action required. Document as known minor conservatism.

cross_cutting_issues.description: PHASE_2_GATE.json open issues note that SandboxRunner uses n_runs=1 instead of the required 5. SAFEGUARD-6 requires ≥5 extractions per program to measure noise floor. With n_runs=1, intra-version variance is unknown.
cross_cutting_issues.corrective_action: Re-run extractions with n_runs=5. Measure intra-version variance. Flag non-deterministic features (std/mean > 0.10) and exclude from genome if needed.

cross_cutting_issues.description: B07_DYNAMIC_V2 reports dev AUROC=0.460 but test AUROC=0.531 — a positive shift of +0.071. This is unusual (dev should approximate test). Possible cause: degenerate threshold (1.000001) on dev triggers different discrimination pattern. Should be investigated to confirm no test-set contamination.
cross_cutting_issues.corrective_action: Verify that threshold was frozen on dev before any test evaluation. Investigate the dev AUROC=0.460 anomaly. Check that dev and test sets have similar label balance (dev: 315/300 pos/neg; test: 366/378 pos/neg — proportions comparable).
